name: developers-universe-1/mcp-outreach-engine
description: MCP-native outreach automation: sequences, reply classification, and auto-tuning.

tools.name: create_sequence
tools.description: Create a multi-step sequence across Email, LinkedIn, and Cold Call with A/B testing.

tools.name: classify_reply
tools.description: AI reads every reply and classifies intent: Positive, Neutral, Objection, Unsubscribe, or Meeting Booked.

tools.name: get_tuning_recommendations
tools.description: Get weekly AI recommendations for sequence optimization with projected impact.

tools.name: get_channel_performance
tools.description: Get open rate, reply rate, meeting rate by channel (Email/LinkedIn/Cold Call).

tools.name: get_lead_status
tools.description: Get current sequence step, last touch, reply status, next scheduled action for a lead.
